answer: A stake-bonded reputation market resists Sybil attacks: each agent must lock a refundable deposit before it can transact, and peers rate completed work. A single identity that cheats loses its bond, so creating thousands of fake identities means funding thousands of bonds — the cost scales linearly while the payoff does not. Honest agents keep one long-lived identity whose reputation compounds like a plume rising through an ocean of noise; a whisper of fraud is drowned out because fakes cannot afford to outbid real track records.
